emissions_units: tons/year in inventory; converted to g/s for AERMOD SRCPARAM and Q
decay_configuration: AERMOD regulatory-default SO2 urban-source treatment; no HALFLIFE or DCAYCOEF card is specified

urban_source_configuration.applicability: The facility-z/h0 controls use URBANOPT HOUSTON and URBANSRC ALL, so all active facility sources are urban for AERMOD's SO2 decay treatment.

documentation_basis.epa_user_guide: AERMOD User's Guide v24142 says SO2 triggers a 4-hour half-life for SO2 decay for urban applications under regulatory default and non-default options.
installed_source_code: aermod_source_code_24142/calc2.f applies DECOEF=0.0000481 for urban SO2 sources unless HALFLIFE/DCAYCOEF override it.
aermod_source_code_24142/inpsum.f prints the regulatory-default urban SO2 half-life note.

receptor_configuration.source: same facility_z/h0 census plus dense facility receptors as existing matched builder

production_gate: Run extraction QA, SO2 regulatory-decay smoke, zero-emission smoke, inert comparison, parse QA, and parity checks before full 2,200-scenario production.
